# Oliver Abraham — Product & Business

Oliver Abraham works directly with owner-managed manufacturing, joinery, furniture and building-product businesses to improve products, processes and the way work gets done. The approach is to understand the people, equipment, information and experience already in a business before recommending more spending.

## Work may include
Product design and engineering; cost and value engineering; CAD, drawings and technical process; range and SKU simplification; manufacturing methods; product information and specifications; training and work instructions; testing and practical investigation; job and administrative process; small internal software tools; useful automation; supplier and project coordination. Oliver is comfortable implementing practical work as well as advising.

## Approach and fit
The work is direct and practical, with owners and operators who are accountable for decisions. It may involve a product change, better drawing, simpler approval, clearer instruction, small software tool, improved job design or stopping work that no longer earns its keep. Technology and AI are tools for business outcomes. The practice is oriented toward short practical engagements rather than large corporate programmes.

## Background
Oliver trained and worked hands-on in joinery and furniture, studied violin making and early stringed instruments, then moved into design, CAD, product development and technical management. Experience includes larger manufacturing organisations and smaller owner-led businesses, as well as independent work in product development, manufacturing, software and testing.

## First engagement
The published offer is one on-site working day in the UK, UK travel included, followed by concise written observations and practical recommendations. Published fee: £1,200. Implementation work is scoped separately.
